v0.5.0.description:
Setup instructions: https://github.com/randomouscrap98/AP_ACGC_PC/blob/master/docs/setup_en.md
Game info: https://github.com/randomouscrap98/AP_ACGC_PC/blob/master/docs/game_info_en.md

This is the last version with breaking changes; future versions should be fully backwards compatible with seeds made from this version onwards, unless otherwise stated.

## New features
- **New goals: Furniture Set + Chess Set**. Items go into the pool, you must set up the set in your house
- **Tracker page for furniture + chess set**. Shows when an item was received from the pool + whether it is detected in your house
- **Extra bells option**. On top of bell credits which automatically apply to your loan, you can also just get money directly in the mail. Careful, set this too high and you'll get a LOT of mail
- **Fossil Loans option**. Make sure you can make a lot of money each day before getting later progressive house loans
- **Shops never sell out option**. Useful for flowers, etc
- **Render scale + fixed scaling**. Rendering now works more like an emulator, which should feel familiar
- **Version-aware slot data**. Slot data is versioned with a compatibility layer; should have backwards compatibility from now on (update software, use on old seed). Forward compatibility is blocked for safety; won't let you play new seeds on old game
- **Nook tells you he's waiting on progressive house**. To reduce confusion
- **Better config experience**. Config is created at startup with expected structure, game starts even with invalid config, more error messages

## Bugfixes
- (Old PC port bug): Rain should no longer crash the game randomly. For those of you on linux, you shouldn't see random textures fly across the screen during rain anymore
- Nook store never renovated with timesanity + early morning
- Mole cricket and pill bug now require the shovel in logic
- Butterflies no longer get stuck in a tight circle (particularly bad for purple butterflies)
- Offline json no longer wraps to unexpected values for out of range ints

## Tweaks
- Better dynamic critters: more pond fish in pond, more bug spawns, etc
- No museum items in pool if museum goal is not on
- AP trackers moved to AP submenu (sorry, was getting too long)
- MSAA off by default (not needed with new auto render scale) and doesn't require a video reset to change
- Resetti disabled by default (you can turn him on anytime)
- Borderless acres disabled by default (you can turn them on anytime)
- Line tweaks to letters
- Moved options around in options creator:
  - Each sanity now has its own group
  - Settings which work regardless of whether the related sanity is on or off moved out of sanity groups
  - New "Matters of Money" group for money options that work all the time
  - New "Goal" group for everything related to goals. Some sanity options (completion % etc) moved here (weren't actually related to sanity, only to the goal)
- Clear generation error when no check is doable at start
- Example yamls as individual files
